blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: intervention — Specific teaching targeting a gap.

blocks.title: Use evidence rather than ticks alone
blocks.text: A topic is secure when a learner can solve an unfamiliar example, not merely recognise its name.

blocks.title: Find links between papers
blocks.text: Paper 1 numerical representation and database knowledge can underpin Paper 2 programming and algorithm questions.

blocks.title: Prioritise gaps
blocks.text: Record the exact misconception or missing step so later Paper 1/2 reteaching sessions target observable weaknesses.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: Bubble sort has quadratic worst-case growth due to repeated adjacent comparisons.

blocks.title: Worked example · Check reasoning
blocks.text: Merge sort has O(n log n) worst-case growth and generally needs O(n) auxiliary memory.

blocks.title: Predict first
blocks.text: Identify exactly which implementation state is wrong, e.g. high never decreases.

blocks.title: Check reasoning
blocks.text: Set a small test with a target below the midpoint to check the high-bound update independently.
